+# Born interval fixed-overlap maximum
+
+## Abstract
+
+The exact Born interval defect maximum at prescribed overlap is attained for every allowed overlap.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Exact maximum over all actual line pairs).**
+
+$$\forall n \in \mathbb{N},\; \forall rho \in \operatorname{Matrix}\left(n, n, \mathbb{C}\right),\; \forall c \in \mathbb{R},\; \forall R \in \operatorname{Sub}\left(\mathbb{C}^{n}\right),\; \forall T \in \operatorname{Sub}\left(\mathbb{C}^{n}\right),\; \forall r \in \mathbb{R},\; ((2 \le n) \land ((\operatorname{PosDef}\left(rho\right)) \land ((\operatorname{Tr}\left(rho\right) = 1) \land ((0 \le c) \land ((T \le \operatorname{orthogonal}\left(R\right)) \land ((\operatorname{dim}\left(T\right) = 2) \land ((0 \le r) \land (r < 1)))))))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{IsGreatest}\left(\operatorname{Defects}\left(rho, c, R, T, r\right), \frac{r(\operatorname{lam}\left(rho, T, 0\right)-\operatorname{lam}\left(rho, T, 1\right))}{c+\operatorname{mu}\left(rho, R\right)+(\operatorname{lam}\left(rho, T, 0\right)+\operatorname{lam}\left(rho, T, 1\right))}\right))$$
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/Algebra/BornJaccardFixedOverlap.fixed_overlap_maximum` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Let n be at least two, rho a positive-definite Hermitian complex matrix of trace one, c a nonnegative real number, R any complex subspace, and T a two-dimensional subspace of the orthogonal complement of R. Neither R nor T must be invariant under rho. All weights and distances are those of BornJaccardTracialClassification, with this same rho. The operator K is the actual composition of inclusion of T, rho, and orthogonal projection onto T. Its sorted eigenvalues are M=lam(0) and m=lam(1). The theorem derives positivity, m at most M, the identity mu(T)=M+m, and positivity of c+mu(R)+M+m.
+
+For every real r with 0 at most r and r strictly below one, there are unit vectors u,v in T with absolute inner product r. Their ambient lines are the images of their spans under the actual inclusion T into H. Both have dimension one, their intersection is zero, and their sum is T. The original meet-over-join distance defect at R+L, R+T, R+N equals r(M-m)/(c+mu(R)+M+m).
+
+Choose an orthonormal eigenbasis e,f of the actual compression in decreasing eigenvalue order. Set a=sqrt((1+r)/2), b=sqrt((1-r)/2), u=ae+bf and v=ae-bf. Both a and b are strictly positive on the full allowed overlap domain. The two vectors have norm one and inner product exactly r. Their sum and difference recover e and f, while comparison of the e and f coordinates proves their spans disjoint. The two line weights are both (M+m+r(M-m))/2.
+
+Write Defects(rho,c,R,T,r) for the set of real d for which there are ordered complex lines L,N in T, both of dimension one, and unit vectors u in L and v in N with absolute inner product r, such that d is the original interval distance defect at R+map(L), R+T, R+map(N). IsGreatest says both that the displayed value belongs to this set and that every member is at most that value. Thus the statement includes every ordered line pair and simultaneous attainment.
+
+For an arbitrary unit pair with eigenbasis coordinates (a,b) and (z,w), the residual-square identity bounds normSq(a)+normSq(z)-1 by the norm of conj(a)z+conj(b)w. The latter is exactly the prescribed overlap. Spectral expansion makes the numerator of the actual defect equal (M-m)(normSq(a)+normSq(z)-1). Multiplication by M-m and division by the derived positive denominator give the universal upper bound.
+
+For every U contained in T, the actual orthogonal projection onto R+U is the sum of the projections onto R and U. Cyclicity of the trace identifies mu(T) with the real trace of the compression; the inner-product compression identity identifies its quadratic forms with those of rho. The actual interval meet and join therefore give defect (mu(L)+mu(N)-mu(T))/(c+mu(R)+mu(T)). This proves the fixed-overlap maximum in Theorem 2.1 of Born-weighted Jaccard projection geometry. The cases r=0, M=m, and c+mu(R)=0 remain included. This is a repository derivation, with no originality claim.

+# First-Return Ground Fixed Space
+
+## Abstract
+
+First-return holonomy classifies fixed vectors supported on one actual lattice charge cycle.
+
+Fix an integral symmetric even lattice datum D, an additive charge automorphism g preserving its bilinear form, an additive sign character chi, and an actual norm-four charge a. Only this charge is required to have a positive return period m; the operator and other charges need not have finite order. Let d be the minimal positive charge period, T the existing corrected lattice lift, e the literal ground vector with charge a, and u the sum of T^j e for zero through d minus one. The subspace S is the literal complex span in Carrier D of the zero-oscillator ground vectors on this charge cycle.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Actual charge-cycle classification and normalization).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/VertexAlgebra/Lattice/CyclicGroundOrbitFixedSpace.first_return_ground_fixed_space`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/VertexAlgebra/Lattice/CyclicGroundOrbitFixedSpace.first_return_ground_fixed_space` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every such D, g, bilinear-preservation proof, chi, a, m, positive-period proof and charge-return proof, the intersection of S with the corrected fixed submodule is the span of u when T^d e equals e, and is zero otherwise. In both branches the actual carrier coefficient of u at charge a and zero oscillator exponent is one, so u is nonzero. The period m is only a witness of periodicity; the criterion always uses d.
+
+The corrected-power formula of CyclicIsometryLift gives the actual phase and charge of every transformed ground vector. The injectivity of charge iterates and Mathlib's minimal-period distinctness isolate each coordinate. Fixedness then transports the starting coefficient around the entire cycle and reconstructs every supported fixed vector as that coefficient times u. The starting coefficient of u is one because only the identity iterate contributes there. Telescoping T u minus u leaves exactly T^d e minus e, which forces the coefficient to vanish when the first-return phase is nontrivial.
+
+A nonzero first-cycle sum can therefore coexist with a zero fixed space: in the obstructed branch u is nonzero but is not fixed. A longer full-period average can cancel even though the first-cycle sum does not. Trivial total phase permits a fixed line even when individual steps have nontrivial phases. This local statement supplies the missing phase-sensitive bridge from charge dynamics to the actual lattice ground sector; the monomial-cycle principle is classical linear algebra and carries no novelty claim.
+
+The result assumes neither rootlessness nor positivity nor finiteness of the whole norm-four shell. It does not yet construct a basis or dimension formula for the full ground span, count neutral oscillator or whole grade-two states, identify the full C2 quotient, or provide a coherent lift of the full isometry group. The source reuses the existing carrierBasis, corrected_pow_single and geometric_shift; no surrogate representation or fixedness premise replaces the actual lattice operator.
+

+   generality: I

+
+/-! Simultaneous actual-line constructions in a two-dimensional projection interval. -/
+
+noncomputable section
+open scoped InnerProductSpace ComplexOrder
+open LinearMap
+namespace D5.S3.Quantum.Algebra.BornJaccardFixedOverlap
+open BornJaccardTracialClassification
+
+variable {n : ℕ}
+
+/-- Compression onto the actual subspace; no invariance is required. -/
+def compression (rho : Module.End ℂ (H n)) (T : Submodule ℂ (H n)) :
+    Module.End ℂ T :=
+  T.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap ∘ₗ rho ∘ₗ T.subtype
+
+private theorem compression_inner (rho : Module.End ℂ (H n))
+    (T : Submodule ℂ (H n)) (x y : T) :
+    inner ℂ x (compression rho T y) = inner ℂ (x : H n) (rho y) := by
+  exact T.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left x (rho y)
+
+private theorem compression_symmetric (rho : Module.End ℂ (H n))
+    (hs : rho.IsSymmetric) (T : Submodule ℂ (H n)) :
+    (compression rho T).IsSymmetric := by
+  intro x y
+  rw [← inner_conj_symm, compression_inner, ← hs, inner_conj_symm,
+    compression_inner]
+
+/-- The two eigenvalues of the actual density compression, in decreasing order. -/
+def intervalEigenvalues (rho : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hp : rho.PosDef)
+    (T : Submodule ℂ (H n)) (hT : Module.finrank ℂ T = 2) : Fin 2 → ℝ :=
+  (compression_symmetric rho.toEuclideanLin
+    (Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hp.isHermitian) T).eigenvalues hT
+
+private theorem compression_trace (rho : Module.End ℂ (H n))
+    (T : Submodule ℂ (H n)) :
+    (LinearMap.trace ℂ T (compression rho T)).re = weight rho T := by
+  unfold weight compression projection
+  change (LinearMap.trace ℂ T
+    (T.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (rho ∘ₗ T.subtype))).re =
+    (LinearMap.trace ℂ (H n)
+      ((rho ∘ₗ T.subtype) ∘ₗ T.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap)).re
+  rw [LinearMap.trace_comp_comm']
+
+private theorem projection_orthogonal_sup (R U : Submodule ℂ (H n))
+    (hU : U ≤ R.orthogonal) :
+    projection (R ⊔ U) = projection R + projection U := by
+  apply LinearMap.ext
+  intro x
+  change (R ⊔ U).starProjection x = R.starProjection x + U.starProjection x
+  apply Submodule.eq_starProjection_of_mem_of_inner_eq_zero
+  · exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (R.starProjection_apply_mem x)
+      (U.starProjection_apply_mem x)
+  · intro y hy
+    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hy
+    have hUR : inner ℂ (U.starProjection x) a = 0 :=
+      R.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal ha (hU (U.starProjection_apply_mem x))
+    have hRU : inner ℂ (R.starProjection x) b = 0 :=
+      R.inner_right_of_mem_orthogonal (R.starProjection_apply_mem x) (hU hb)
+    have hR := R.starProjection_inner_eq_zero x a ha
+    have hV := U.starProjection_inner_eq_zero x b hb
+    simp only [inner_sub_left] at hR hV
+    simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_add_left, inner_add_right]
+    rw [hUR, hRU]
+    linear_combination hR + hV
+
+private theorem weight_orthogonal_sup (rho : Module.End ℂ (H n))
+    (R U : Submodule ℂ (H n)) (hU : U ≤ R.orthogonal) :
+    weight rho (R ⊔ U) = weight rho R + weight rho U := by
+  simp only [weight, projection_orthogonal_sup R U hU, mul_add, map_add, Complex.add_re]
+
+private theorem interval_inf (R T L N : Submodule ℂ (H n))
+    (hT : T ≤ R.orthogonal) (hL : L ≤ T) (hN : N ≤ T) (hLN : L ⊓ N = ⊥) :
+    (R ⊔ L) ⊓ (R ⊔ N) = R := by
+  apply le_antisymm _ (le_inf le_sup_left le_sup_left)
+  intro x hx
+  obtain ⟨a, ha, u, hu, hxu⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx.1
+  obtain ⟨b, hb, v, hv, hxv⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx.2
+  have huv : u - v ∈ R := by
+    have heq : u - v = b - a := by
+      calc
+        u - v = (a + u) - (a + v) := by module
+        _ = (b + v) - (a + v) := by rw [hxu, hxv]
+        _ = b - a := by module
+    rw [heq]
+    exact R.sub_mem hb ha
+  have huvT : u - v ∈ R.orthogonal := hT (T.sub_mem (hL hu) (hN hv))
+  have huv0 : u - v = 0 := by
+    have h := (show u - v ∈ R ⊓ R.orthogonal from ⟨huv, huvT⟩)
+    simpa only [R.inf_orthogonal_eq_bot, Submodule.mem_bot] using h
+  have huv' : u = v := sub_eq_zero.mp huv0
+  have hu0 : u = 0 := by
+    have h : u ∈ L ⊓ N := ⟨hu, huv'.symm ▸ hv⟩
+    simpa only [hLN, Submodule.mem_bot] using h
+  simpa [← hxu, hu0] using ha
+
+private theorem weight_unit_line (rho : Module.End ℂ (H n)) (w : H n)
+    (hw : inner ℂ w w = 1) : weight rho (ℂ ∙ w) = (inner ℂ w (rho w)).re := by
+  have hn : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (1 : ℝ) := by
+    have h := congrArg Complex.re hw
+    norm_num [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, pow_two, Complex.mul_re] at h
+    nlinarith
+  have hP : projection (ℂ ∙ w) = (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ w w).toLinearMap := by
+    ext v
+    simp [projection, Submodule.starProjection_singleton, hn,
+      InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply]
+  rw [weight, hP, trace_mul_rank]
+
+private theorem interval_defect (rho : Module.End ℂ (H n))
+    (c : ℝ) (R T L N : Submodule ℂ (H n))
+    (hT : T ≤ R.orthogonal) (hL : L ≤ T) (hN : N ≤ T)
+    (hLN : L ⊓ N = ⊥) (hjoin : L ⊔ N = T)
+    (hden : 0 < c + weight rho R + weight rho T) :
+    distance rho c (R ⊔ L) (R ⊔ N) -
+        distance rho c (R ⊔ L) (R ⊔ T) -
+        distance rho c (R ⊔ T) (R ⊔ N) =
+      (weight rho L + weight rho N - weight rho T) /
+        (c + weight rho R + weight rho T) := by
+  have hLT : R ⊔ L ≤ R ⊔ T := sup_le_sup_left hL R
+  have hNT : R ⊔ N ≤ R ⊔ T := sup_le_sup_left hN R
+  have hj : (R ⊔ L) ⊔ (R ⊔ N) = R ⊔ T := by
+    rw [← hjoin]
+    ac_rfl
+  have hi := interval_inf R T L N hT hL hN hLN
+  have hwt := weight_orthogonal_sup rho R T hT
+  have hwl := weight_orthogonal_sup rho R L (hL.trans hT)
+  have hwn := weight_orthogonal_sup rho R N (hN.trans hT)
+  have hd : c + (weight rho R + weight rho T) ≠ 0 := by linarith
+  simp only [distance, hj, hi, sup_eq_right.mpr hLT, inf_eq_left.mpr hLT,
+    sup_eq_left.mpr hNT, inf_eq_right.mpr hNT, hwt, hwl, hwn, ite_eq_right hd]
+  field_simp [ne_of_gt hden, hd]
+  ring
+
+private theorem pair_construction (rho : Module.End ℂ (H n)) (e f : H n)
+    (hee : inner ℂ e e = 1) (hff : inner ℂ f f = 1)
+    (hef : inner ℂ e f = 0) (M m r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1)
+    (hqee : inner ℂ e (rho e) = (M : ℂ))
+    (hqff : inner ℂ f (rho f) = (m : ℂ))
+    (hqef : inner ℂ e (rho f) = 0) (hqfe : inner ℂ f (rho e) = 0) :
+    ∃ u v : H n,
+      u ∈ (ℂ ∙ e) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ f) ∧ v ∈ (ℂ ∙ e) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ f) ∧
+      inner ℂ u u = 1 ∧ inner ℂ v v = 1 ∧ inner ℂ u v = (r : ℂ) ∧
+      (ℂ ∙ u) ⊓ (ℂ ∙ v) = ⊥ ∧
+      (ℂ ∙ u) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ v) = (ℂ ∙ e) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ f) ∧
+      weight rho (ℂ ∙ u) = (M + m + r * (M - m)) / 2 ∧
+      weight rho (ℂ ∙ v) = (M + m + r * (M - m)) / 2 := by
+  let a : ℝ := Real.sqrt ((1 + r) / 2)
+  let b : ℝ := Real.sqrt ((1 - r) / 2)
+  have ha : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
+  have hb : 0 < b := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
+  have haa : a ^ 2 = (1 + r) / 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
+  have hbb : b ^ 2 = (1 - r) / 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
+  have hab : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1 := by linarith
+  have hab' : a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 = r := by linarith
+  have hac : (a : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt ha
+  have hbc : (b : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hb
+  have hfe : inner ℂ f e = 0 := by rw [← inner_conj_symm, hef, map_zero]
+  let u : H n := (a : ℂ) • e + (b : ℂ) • f
+  let v : H n := (a : ℂ) • e - (b : ℂ) • f
+  let E : Submodule ℂ (H n) := (ℂ ∙ e) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ f)
+  have huE : u ∈ E := E.add_mem
+    (Submodule.mem_sup_left ((ℂ ∙ e).smul_mem _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self e)))

+/-- Literal zero-oscillator ground span on the first-return charge cycle. -/
+def groundCycleSpan (D : LatticeData) (g : Charge D ≃+ Charge D)
+    (a : NormFour D) : Submodule ℂ (Carrier D) :=
+  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fun i : Fin (Function.minimalPeriod g a.1) =>
+    Finsupp.single (g^[i.1] a.1) (1 : Oscillator D)))
+
+private def coeff (D : LatticeData) (b : Charge D) : Carrier D →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
+  (carrierBasis D).coord (b, 0)
+
+private theorem coeff_ground (D : LatticeData) (b c : Charge D) :
+    coeff D c (Finsupp.single b (1 : Oscillator D)) = if b = c then 1 else 0 := by
+  classical
+  change ((Finsupp.single b (1 : Oscillator D)) c).coeff 0 = _
+  by_cases h : b = c <;> simp [h]
+
+private def phase (D : LatticeData) (g : Charge D ≃+ Charge D)
+    (chi : Charge D →+ F₂) (j : ℕ) (b : Charge D) : ℂ :=
+  complexSign (orbitExponent D g j b + chi (orbitNorm D g j b))

+private theorem power_ground (D : LatticeData) (g : Charge D ≃+ Charge D)
+    (hg : ∀ b c, bilinear D (g b) (g c) = bilinear D b c)
+    (chi : Charge D →+ F₂) (j : ℕ) (b : Charge D) :
+    (corrected D g chi ^ j) (Finsupp.single b (1 : Oscillator D)) =
+      phase D g chi j b • Finsupp.single (g^[j] b) (1 : Oscillator D) := by
+  simpa only [map_one, phase] using corrected_pow_single D g hg chi j b 1

+private theorem cycle_coeff (D : LatticeData) (g : Charge D ≃+ Charge D)
+    (a : NormFour D) (k : Fin (Function.minimalPeriod g a.1))
+    (c : Fin (Function.minimalPeriod g a.1) → ℂ) :
+    coeff D (g^[k.1] a.1)
+      (∑ i, c i • Finsupp.single (g^[i.1] a.1) (1 : Oscillator D)) = c k := by

+  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, coeff_ground, smul_eq_mul]
+  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
+  · simp
+  · intro i _ hik
+    have hne : g^[i.1] a.1 ≠ g^[k.1] a.1 := by
+      intro h
+      exact hik (Fin.ext ((Function.iterate_eq_iterate_iff_of_lt_minimalPeriod

+    simp [hne]
+  · simp

+    (hg : ∀ b c, bilinear D (g b) (g c) = bilinear D b c)
+    (chi : Charge D →+ F₂) (a : NormFour D) (j : ℕ)

+    rw [power_ground D g hg, map_smul, coeff_ground, coeff_ground]
+    have hinj : Function.Injective (g^[j]) := g.injective.iterate j
+    by_cases hi : g^[i.1] a.1 = a.1
+    · simp [hi]
+    · simp [hi, hinj.eq_iff]

+  | smul r x _ hx =>

+    ring

+    (hg : ∀ b c, bilinear D (g b) (g c) = bilinear D b c)

+  simp only [phaseFilteredGroundOrbit, chargeGroundVector, power_ground D g hg]

+

+    (hg : ∀ b c, bilinear D (g b) (g c) = bilinear D b c)

+  simpa [phase, orbitExponent, orbitNorm, complexSign] using h

+    (hg : ∀ b c, bilinear D (g b) (g c) = bilinear D b c)

+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro i _
+  rw [hcoeff, smul_smul, mul_comm]

+  apply Submodule.sum_mem
+  intro i _

+    (hg : ∀ b c, bilinear D (g b) (g c) = bilinear D b c)

+  · rw [ite_eq_left hr]

+      change corrected D g chi u - u = 0
+      apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
+      change corrected D g chi (∑ j ∈ Finset.range d,

+      rw [geometric_shift, hr, add_sub_cancel_right]
+      rfl
+    apply le_antisymm
+    · intro v hv
